name: dewclaw
title: Dewclaw
description: A vet's theme built as the kennel card in a steel holder on a ward door: a white card held by four riveted corner tabs on brushed steel, brown-captioned boxes in rounded marker caps, tick boxes for what to do before a visit, and a red-edged out-of-hours box on every page.

tokens.--font-marker: rounded marker caps: titles, care names, steps, phone numbers, times, site name, buttons
tokens.--font-body: humanist sans: reading text, captions, menu
tokens.--text-caption: the small printed captions over each box, table headings, h4
tokens.--text-s: small text: hours, address, e-mail, dates, Book button, footer
tokens.--text-m: base body size, and the steps in the Before-you-come-in box
tokens.--text-l: ledes, site name, list titles, section headings in page text
tokens.--text-phone: the phone numbers in the Call and Out-of-hours boxes
tokens.--text-title: the marker heading of every page
tokens.--leading-tight: line height of headings, phone numbers and buttons
tokens.--color-bg: the brushed-steel kennel door: the page background
tokens.--color-steel-hi: the light grain of the steel; also code backgrounds
tokens.--color-steel-lo: the dark grain of the steel and the rivet rims
tokens.--color-holder: the steel holder plate round the card and its four corner tabs
tokens.--color-holder-lip: the bright edge of the holder and upper tabs, rivet heads, the shine under the site name
tokens.--color-shade: shadows: under the holder, along the tabs, inside the card's top edge
tokens.--color-text: marker-black ink: headings, text, phone numbers, menu, footer, hover tick, focus rings
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: post-list dates and summaries, the empty-list line
tokens.--color-accent: collar-leather brown: captions, box and list rules, tick boxes, links, the Book button
tokens.--color-emergency: the red edge of the out-of-hours box, used nowhere else
tokens.--page-width: maximum width of the door, card and footer
tokens.--measure: maximum width of reading text on the card
tokens.--side-width: width of the phone, hours and address column on wide screens
tokens.--tab: size of the four steel corner tabs that hold the card
tokens.--rule: thickness of the box rules, tick boxes and table rules
tokens.--rule-bold: thickness of the In-for box, the rule under headings, the out-of-hours edge, quotes
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the steel holder
tokens.--space-3: base spacing step and the side gutter
tokens.--space-4: large spacing step and the card's inner margin
tokens.--space-5: largest spacing step: above section headings and between the card's columns
tokens.--tap-target: minimum touch height for menu, Book button, site name and page links
